description: A new session picks up a day that already has files. `## Resume` step 1 runs the lane audit, and one tree holds uncommitted work whose writer is not in `## Sessions` any more — the row that names it is keyed `nobody`, so no lane points at it either. The audit reports per tree and this is a fact about owners, so until the join it was found by nobody. `Verified` is where a checked fact goes.

turns.prompt: Pick up where the last session left off.

graders.name: it asks the audit rather than guessing
the reply names the tree whose writer is gone
and says the work in it is uncommitted
the orphaned tree reaches Verified, where a checked fact goes
Log times are this move's clock reads
